architecture_conclusion.thesis: The credible current-contract reduction is duplicated process-local representation, derivation and fixture construction around a real durable protocol. The subsystem has several removable layer chains, but the durable heads/receipts, independent read phases and distinct root/history/projection authorities protect different facts.

layer_chains.chain: Record fields → parallel Parts/EncoderWork fields → field-copy bridges → provisional record → digest → reconstructed final record → duplicated prepared effect.
layer_chains.decision: Collapse private payload/carry/update representations and borrow the exact effect already owned by the settlement. Keep constructor validation, source-versus-target ownership and separately durable record encodings. This removes the need for conversion layers rather than merely renaming constructors.

layer_chains.chain: Typed or observation source → first counting encode → second narrative counting encode → durable staging encode → production streaming validation → independent bounded test decoder.
layer_chains.decision: Remove the second counting encode by retaining one optional narrative span until the first final digest is known. Share physical byte writing between source traversals. Actual durable staging, complete source validation and exact completion comparison remain; the bounded decoder remains an independent oracle, not redundant production machinery.

layer_chains.chain: Writer, public query and scrub each acquire authority → repeated pure route/phase/order/stack formulas → boundary-specific classification.
layer_chains.decision: Share exact pure calculations and narrowly bounded byte transport, while retaining independent acquisition times, required read meters, stable-drift checks, physical orphan scans and domain-specific errors. A common all-purpose reader or snapshot would hide meaningful temporal and fault boundaries and is not justified.

layer_chains.chain: Populated fixture constructs obsolete provider records → both callers filter them out → real provider commands later seed the authoritative records.
layer_chains.decision: Delete the provably discarded producer chain first, including the392-line item_records module and producer-only facts. Then share positive fixture construction. Keep the real provider seed and the temporary store that supplies retained empty draft/history references; constructor purity is essential to the deletion claim.

layer_chains.chain: Many fixture-specific TestHome types and ordinary-edit constructors → included support modules → repeated caller adaptation.
layer_chains.decision: Use one feature-neutral temporary-home implementation and one ordinary-edit core, paying shared helper cost once. Adapt narrow callers with explicit IDs, history budgets, caret/selection and prepared endpoints; never share independently expected codec/charge/fault results.

retained_responsibilities: The sequence tree answers positional text/marker questions; the identity index proves stable marker occurrence/uniqueness; the marker-order tree commits marker order, count and maximum label. Source-order and target-id admission indexes have different key/consumption duties. One in-memory map cannot substitute for their authenticated durable node and bounded command contracts.

Staging owns streamed authored input and release/replay custody; build progress owns bounded path-copy continuation; settlement owns one exact logical outcome; publication selects a captured candidate/history pair. Removing a process wrapper does not remove one of these durable responsibilities.

Historical transitions/ancestry witnesses make logarithmic lineage retention and direct-root undo possible without replaying inverse bytes. Published/newest history differs intentionally; a root match alone does not make a candidate saved.

Materializer planning establishes digest-derived content identity before output writes; writing/draining bound chunks and indexes; atomic sealing alone exposes the exact-root content mapping. A synchronous resident fold does not preserve resumable arbitrary-size operation.

Binding, stop and compaction witnesses distinguish definite non-dispatch, possible dispatch, exact terminal authority and ordinary/provider-specific successors. Generic state-machine crates cannot replace those effects and provenance.

Typed values, exact codec bytes, writer-time admission, point-read closure checks and exhaustive physical scrub answer different validity questions. Shared formulas must not make production constructors the independent corruption or byte oracle.
